translations.web: Yahweh’s angel appeared to him, and said to him, “Yahweh is with you, you mighty man of valor!”
translations.bsb: And the angel of the LORD appeared to Gideon and said, “The LORD is with you, O mighty man of valor.”
translations.kjv: And the angel of the LORD appeared unto him, and said unto him, The LORD is with thee, thou mighty man of valour.
translations.asv: And the angel of Jehovah appeared unto him, and said unto him, Jehovah is with thee, thou mighty man of valor.
